screenshotassistant.title: Screenshot Assistant
screenshotassistant.section.storage.hint: Screenshots are saved with Minecraft's standard timestamp filename (e.g. 2026-08-04_12.34.56.png). Per-rule sub-folders are configured in each rule's editor.
screenshotassistant.section.rapidfire.hi: Allow multiple back-to-back screenshots in quick succession, bypassing the global cooldown for consecutive rule matches.
screenshotassistant.section.effects.hint: Effects shown when an automatic screenshot fires.
screenshotassistant.section.stacked.hint: Show consecutive screenshot alerts as a visible on-screen stack. Newest at the bottom, older entries shift up and fade out.
screenshotassistant.option.modLanguage.t: Language used in all Screenshot Assistant screens. Independent of Minecraft's game language.
screenshotassistant.option.cooldownSecon: Minimum gap between screenshots in normal mode. Set to 0 to disable. When Rapid-Fire is ON, this is replaced by the rapid-fire interval instead.
screenshotassistant.option.captureDelayM: Wait this many ms after a matching message arrives before taking the screenshot. Set 700-750 if you use 'Chat Animations' mod. 0 = capture immediately.
screenshotassistant.option.fixTooltipPos: Moves all in-game tooltips 100 px down so they appear BELOW the cursor. Affects every screen because Minecraft has a centralised tooltip renderer. Disable if you prefer vanilla behaviour.
screenshotassistant.option.enableRapidFi: Allow consecutive screenshots to fire as fast as every N ms (see 'Rapid-fire interval' below), bypassing the global cooldown for back-to-back rule matches. Useful when many rules can fire within seconds of each other.
screenshotassistant.option.rapidFireInte: Minimum gap between screenshots when rapid-fire mode is active. Default: 200 ms. Range: 50–2000 ms.
Where all mod screenshots are saved. Leave EMPTY for .minecraft/screenshots. Non-empty = absolute path. Per-rule sub-folders are appended under this base.
screenshotassistant.option.weeklyRotatio: Each week, screenshots go into a new dated sub-folder. The folder is created on the first screenshot of that week.
GREGORIAN or JALALI (Solar Hijri). Affects both date-range and week-number naming.
Day of week that begins a new rotation folder. Default: Thursday (4).
screenshotassistant.option.weekStartHour: Hour of day (0–23) at which the new weekly folder begins. Default: 0 (midnight).
screenshotassistant.option.enableCapture: Play a sound effect when an automatic screenshot is taken. Disabled by default.
Which sound plays on capture: CAMERA (UI toast), XP_ORB, LEVEL_UP, NOTE_PLING, or NONE.
screenshotassistant.option.captureSoundV: Volume of the capture sound as a percentage. 100% = normal. 0% = silent. Max 150%. Default: 100%.
screenshotassistant.option.enableRainbow: Colour the 'Screenshot saved' text shown in the action bar. Disabled when Cinematic Subtitle or Stacked Notifications are ON.
screenshotassistant.option.messageColorM: Colour style for the HUD notification: RAINBOW cycles through 7 colours; others are fixed.
screenshotassistant.option.enableCinemat: Shows a subtitle via Minecraft's title system on each screenshot. The animation RESTARTS on every consecutive screenshot — it never blocks the next one.
Text shown in the cinematic subtitle and in stacked notifications. Supports any Unicode including emoji. Leave empty for the default: '📸 Screenshot Saved!'
screenshotassistant.option.subtitleColor: Colour for the cinematic subtitle and stacked notification entries. Default: GOLD.
screenshotassistant.option.showScreensho: Prepend the per-folder screenshot counter to the notification text, e.g. '📸 #42 Screenshot Saved!'. The counter resets when the target folder changes. The actual filename still uses the Minecraft timestamp format.
screenshotassistant.option.enableStacked: Show consecutive screenshot alerts as a vertical stack in the HUD. Each new alert appears at the anchor point; older alerts shift away and fade out sooner.
screenshotassistant.option.maxStackedNot: Maximum simultaneous stack entries. Range: 1–10. Default: 3.
screenshotassistant.option.notificationP: Where the stacked notification stack is anchored. TOP_* = newest at top, stack grows down. BOTTOM_* = newest at bottom, stack grows up. LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT = horizontal alignment.
To move your config to another device: ① Delete screenshotassistant.json on the target device. ② Copy-paste this file into the same folder. Then restart Minecraft.
screenshotassistant.option.openConfigFol: Toggle ON and press Save to open the config folder in your OS file manager. Toggle resets automatically.
